rationale: Sidra is an engineer working with Python, PyTorch, and TensorFlow—the core ML stack—while Evan leads AI at Expo and is actively building AI-driven tooling for developers. Evan's work on making AI apps universally deployable across platforms complements Sidra's ML engineering background, and both are based in San Francisco, making this a natural pairing to explore how production ML systems integrate with modern app development frameworks.
intro_message: Sidra Miconi, meet Evan Bacon — you're both building at the intersection of AI and developer tools, and Evan's work on Expo Agent for deploying AI apps could be a natural fit for discussion given your ML engineering background.
